title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p19p: Dead variable assignments in Ack::write_to
description:
## Dead code in Ack::write_to

**File:** `rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs:284-285`

```rust
let n = kept;
let body_bytes = n.div_ceil(8);
```

Both `n` and `body_bytes` are computed but never used. In the old code, these were used to size the output. The new code uses a different approach (set_bit on individual positions) but left these unused assignments behind.

**Fix:** Remove the dead assignments.
